You are a careful trip planner for ONE day in Singapore. Plan a schedule that satisfies ALL of the
traveller's requirements, using only the facts below. Requirements include: total budget, the time window
of the day, places that must be visited, the order they ask for, times they give for specific places, and
how long they want to stay. Each visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical duration unless the traveller
gives one), must be inside the place's opening hours, shows can only start at a listed showtime, visits
cannot overlap, and you need the listed travel time between consecutive stops (and from/to the starting
place if one is given). Optional places should be included only if everything still fits.
If no schedule can satisfy every requirement, answer feasible=false with an empty visits list and say why.

Places (id | name | cost SGD | typical minutes | open-close | showtimes):
garden_rhapsody | Garden Rhapsody | 0 | 15 | 19:30-21:15 | 19:45, 20:45
merlion_park | Merlion Park | 0 | 30 | 00:00-24:00 | -
national_gallery | National Gallery Singapore | 25 | 150 | 10:00-19:00 | -
national_museum | National Museum of Singapore | 15 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
east_coast_lagoon | East Coast Lagoon Food Village | 15 | 60 | 10:30-22:30 | -
tekka_centre | Tekka Centre | 8 | 45 | 06:30-21:00 | -
orchid_garden | National Orchid Garden | 15 | 60 | 08:30-19:00 | -

national_museum: garden_rhapsody 16, merlion_park 14, national_gallery 12, east_coast_lagoon 33, tekka_centre 13, orchid_garden 20
east_coast_lagoon: garden_rhapsody 30, merlion_park 32, national_gallery 33, national_museum 33, tekka_centre 33, orchid_garden 42
tekka_centre: garden_rhapsody 18, merlion_park 16, national_gallery 15, national_museum 13, east_coast_lagoon 33, orchid_garden 20
orchid_garden: garden_rhapsody 26, merlion_park 23, national_gallery 22, national_museum 20, east_coast_lagoon 42, tekka_centre 20

Answer with JSON only: {"feasible": bool, "visits": [{"location_id": id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM"}],
"reason": short string}. Times are 24-hour HH:MM.

I'm free from 11:00 to 22:00. My budget is S$102. I definitely need to see Garden Rhapsody and National Orchid Garden. If there's time, I'd also like Merlion Park, National Gallery Singapore, National Museum of Singapore, East Coast Lagoon Food Village and Tekka Centre. I'd like to spend 30 minutes at National Orchid Garden.
